filled.focus_intro: Banza wubake rectangle, hanyuma uhuze ishusho n'urutonde rwo kugwiza, place value, n'ibibazo vy'amajambo vy'ubuzima nyakuri.

filled.a_b_is_the_area_of_an_a_by_b_rectangle: a × b ni ubuso bw'akayira k'impande enye a na b. Iyi ni ikiraro kuva ku kubara usimbuka kugera ku kugwiza. Common Core 3.MD.7: huza ubuso no kugwiza no kongera.
filled.distributive_split_the_rectangle_keep_: Kugabanya — tandukanya akayira k'impande enye, ubike ubuso
filled.a_b_c_ab_ac_cut_a_4_7_grid_into_a_4_5_: a(b+c) = ab + ac. Ca urusobe rwa 4×7 mu 4×5 + 4×2; igiteranyo kimwe. Imiterere yo kugabanya ni urutirigongo rwa algebra rw'aguka kose gukurikira. Common Core 3.OA.5.
filled.break_factors_by_place_value_23_47_20_: Tandukanya ibice ukurikije agaciro k'umwanya: 23×47 = (20+3)(40+7) = 800 + 140 + 120 + 21 = 1081. Ikiraro kigana uburyo bw'urusobe, hanyuma algorithm isanzwe. Common Core 4.NBT.5.
filled.a_garden_with_4_rows_of_6_plants_a_the: Ubusitani bufite imirongo 4 y'ibimera 6. Ikinamico gifite imirongo 8 y'intebe 12. Buri kuri kw'ukuri kugwiza kubaho mu kayira k'impande enye k'isi nyayo. Common Core 3.OA.3, 4.OA.2.
